## Context

`docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md` calls the enforced module limit a soft cap and embeds dated tool inventory, machine state, measurements, findings, and capture debris as maintained procedure. The packaged `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/SKILL.md` owns the audit phases. Ticket unafraid-homey-umbrette records the complexity ratchet, and scabby-slur-junk records a prior audit finding.

## Plan

- Rewrite the runbook as a rebar-project adapter to the packaged janitor workflow.
- Retain project gate commands and the command inputs needed to run them.
- Require rebar session logs and tickets for durable progress, decisions, and discovered work.
- State that the module limit is an absolute CI gate sourced from `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.
- Remove dated observations and capture debris from maintained procedure.
- Refer to historical tickets when prior findings provide context.
- Execute the documented read-only commands and run documentation link checks.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The runbook delegates audit phases to the packaged janitor skill.
- [x] Project-specific gate commands remain documented and executable.
- [x] Session logs and tickets are required as the durable artifacts for this repository.
- [x] The module limit is described as an absolute CI gate sourced from `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.
- [x] Dated machine state, measurements, findings, and capture debris are absent from maintained procedure.
- [x] Historical context points to tickets instead of restating incident narratives.
- [x] Documented read-only commands and documentation link checks pass.
